title: घिमिरेका कवितामा विरोधजन्य सौन्दर्य
nepali: प्रस्तुत अध्ययनमा कवि माधव घिमिरेका कवितामा निहित विरोधजन्य सौन्दर्यको विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । घिमिरेका कवितामा प्रयुक्त विरोधमूलक वर्गका अलङ्कारले विरोधजन्य सौन्दर्यको सिर्जना गरेका छन् । कवि माधव घिमिरेका कविहरूमा विरोधविच्छित्तिमूलक वर्गका विभिन्न एघारओटा अलङ्कारहरूको प्रयोग भएको पाइन्छ । यी एघारओटा अलङ्कारहरू प्रयोग भएका कवितांशहरूमा अनेक विरोधी विचार वा चिन्तनका बीच पनि सामञ्जस्य कायम गरिएको पाइन्छ । विरोधी चिन्तन वा सोचाइलाई कवि घिमिरेले उचित समन्यव गरी सौन्दर्यको सृष्टि गरेका छन् । कवि घिमिरेका विभिन्न कवितांशहरूमा केकस्ता विरोधजन्य वस्तुहरूका बीच सन्तुलन गरी सौन्दर्यको सृष्टि गरिएको छ भन्ने कुराको निरूपण यस लेखमा गरिएको छ । प्रस्तुत लेखको सामग्री विश्लेषणका क्रममा प्राथमिक सामग्रीका रूपमा कवि घिमिरेका फुटकर कविताहरूलाई उपयोग गरिएको छ भने द्वितीयक सामग्रीका रूपमा कवि घिमिरेका कविताका सम्बन्धमा प्रकाश पारी लेखिएका पुस्तक, लेख, अनुसन्धान र अलङ्कार सिद्धान्तसँग सम्बन्धित संस्कृत भाषाका पुस्तकहरूको उपयोग गरिएको छ । सौन्दर्य विश्लेषणका क्रममा वर्णनात्मक, विश्लेषणात्मक र व्याख्यात्मक विधिको प्रयोग गरिएको छ भने चरका रूपमा सोद्देश्य कवितांशहरूको छनोट गरिएको छ ।
american_english: In this study, the aesthetic of opposition inherent in the poetry of poet Madhav Ghimire has been analyzed. The figures of speech of the oppositional category used in Ghimire's poetry have created this aesthetic of opposition. Across the poems of poet Madhav Ghimire, the use of eleven different figures of speech belonging to the paradox-based category is found. In the poetic excerpts where these eleven figures of speech are used, harmony is found to be maintained even amidst numerous opposing ideas or perspectives. By properly harmonizing contradictory thoughts or viewpoints, poet Ghimire has created aesthetic beauty. An examination of what kinds of opposing elements are balanced to create beauty across various poetic excerpts of poet Ghimire is carried out in this article. During the material analysis of this article, poet Ghimire's miscellaneous poems were utilized as primary materials, while books, articles, and research elucidating poet Ghimire's poetry along with Sanskrit-language books related to the theory of poetic figures were utilized as secondary materials. In the course of aesthetic analysis, descriptive, analytical, and interpretive methods have been used, while purposively selected poetic excerpts were chosen as variables.

informal_english: In this study, we take a proper look at the aesthetic of opposition running through poet Madhav Ghimire's poetry. The figures of speech from the oppositional class that Ghimire uses in his poetry have created this real aesthetic of opposition. Across poet Madhav Ghimire's poems, you'll find the use of eleven different figures of speech belonging to the paradox-based category. In the poetic excerpts where these eleven figures of speech crop up, harmony is still found to be maintained even amidst numerous opposing ideas or perspectives. By properly harmonising contradictory thoughts or viewpoints, poet Ghimire has created genuine aesthetic beauty. An examination of what sorts of opposing elements are balanced against each other to create beauty across poet Ghimire's various poetic excerpts is carried out in this article. During the material analysis of this article, poet Ghimire's miscellaneous poems were used as primary materials, while books, articles, and research elucidating poet Ghimire's poetry along with Sanskrit-language books on the theory of poetic figures were used as secondary materials. In the course of aesthetic analysis, descriptive, analytical, and interpretive methods were used, while purposively selected poetic excerpts were picked as variables.
